chief_complaint: Blood sugar was high for a few days but seems better now. Just got back from vacation.

symptom_diary.entry: First day of cruise vacation. Buffet food everywhere, tried to be careful but ate more carbs than usual.
Blood sugar 210 this morning. Probably all the desserts yesterday. Still taking metformin.
Still elevated. Eating out every meal on this ship. Hard to control what's in the food.
Back to normal food at home. Blood sugar already coming back down to 145.

medication_adherence.notes: Very consistent with medications. Never misses doses. The spike was purely dietary during vacation.

lifestyle.diet: Usually careful with carbohydrates. Vacation was an exception.

family_history.notes: Father and one sibling have Type 2 diabetes

patient_concerns: Concerned about the glucose spike on vacation. Wants to know if he should have adjusted his medication during travel.
